text:
ashley: Heads up: coalescer p50 latency up ~18% after yesterday's CUDA13.4p1 + allocator tweak in runtime-main. Seen on canary small-batch runs. cc @kevin @ravi :eyes:
kevin: Link to the CI perf job?
ci-bot: CI perf: https://ci.redwood.ai/12345 — test=smallbatch-latency; regression detected 2026-03-17T22:10Z. baseline p50=12.0ms -> now p50=14.2ms (+18%).
ravi: That allocator change was PR #4567 — it lowered pooling thresholds and enabled more aggressive return-to-driver. Could make `cudaMalloc`/`cuMemAlloc` show up more.
ashley: Profiled a couple of sample requests. Coalescer time shifted from kernel dispatch into allocator spikes during merge phase. Snippet:
```
# perf breakdown (sample)
coalescer_loop    45.2%
dispatch_kernel    20.1%
cudaMalloc         18.7%  <-- new hotspot
kv_prefetch         7.0%
other               9.0%
```
kevin: Huh. Why would coalescer call cudaMalloc per mini-batch? It should reuse buffers. Any evidence pooling is returning memory?
ashley: Heap snapshots show `pooled_count` drops ~30% between steps (pool flushes). Looks like return_threshold is too low, pool aggressively trims.
diane: Can you paste the commit/flag? I can try a quick revert in canary.
ravi: Commit hash: abcdef1. Flag introduced `runtime.alloc.return_threshold=0.2` (previous default ~0.8).
kevin: If we bump it back to 0.8 we likely regain behavior. But also want to rule out CUDA13.4p1 allocation latency change. @ci-bot can you run a microbench matrix: CUDA=13.3 vs 13.4p1 and allocator flag toggles?
ci-bot: Matrix queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/12400 — combinations: {CUDA:13.3,13.4p1} x {alloc.return_threshold:0.2,0.8} x {Triton:2.5.8,2.6.1}. Will report.
ashley: Also seeing more interleaved KV-cache prefetch work during coalescer merges; those tasks allocate small scratch buffers, so interaction plausible.
ravi: I'll add NVTX around coalescer and the allocator and run on a canary A100. Quick command: 
```
export NVTX=1
LD_PRELOAD=./liballoc-trace.so ./bin/serve --model gpt-small --batcher coalescer --canary
```
kevin: If allocator tweak is safe for long term, we should still make coalescer reuse staging buffers so transient allocs are avoided. That may be less risky than keeping the old pool sizing forever.
diane: I'll open a hotfix PR to restore the old threshold while we investigate. If matrix shows CUDA/Triton changes are also contributors we'll coordinate with infra. :thumbsup:
ashley: Posted flamegraphs from the canary run: https://perf.redwood.ai/flame/3099990000 — shows clear malloc spikes between merge->dispatch.
ravi: FYI Triton 2.6.1 landed yesterday on some nodes and can change kernel workspace behavior. Adding Triton to the matrix was a good call.
ci-bot: Matrix updated, will post results as separate comments.
kevin: Action items: 1) NVTX traces (ravi), 2) CI microbench matrix (ci-bot), 3) hotfix revert PR (diane), 4) targeted microbench allocator latency (ashley).
ashley: I'll share allocator microbench results here once done. Short-term revert if hotfix shows <2% impact on other workloads :hammer:
